articles.summary: We’re excited to share an important milestone for Letter AI and for the enterprise teams we serve.In the newly released G2 Winter 2026 Reports, Letter AI earned 21 badges across Sales Enablement, AI Chatbots, AI Coaching, and Digital Sales Rooms — up from 6 badges last winter.
articles.title: Letter AI Earns Highest Momentum in Sales Enablement and 21 G2 Winter Badges
